{"id":"JMAP-0x0q.67","title":"vtc: answer after ring timeout, expire_ring tests","description":"vtc: answering after ring timeout, expire_ring coverage, small doc/test cleanups (batch 8b review, JMAP-8mem.7/.8, JMAP-0x0q.30).
